name: DORA Metrics (DevOps Research & Assessment)
description: Four key metrics measuring software delivery performance: Deployment Frequency, Lead Time for Changes, Change Failure Rate, and Time to Restore Service. Classifies teams into Elite/High/Medium/Low performers.
reputation: Research-backed framework from Google's DORA team; free measurement guide; State of DevOps report.
notes: Metrics can be gamed; context matters (not all systems need elite deployment frequency).
